comment: Task #1724 Phase 4.4 — Baseline snapshot of pg_stat_statements,
Each entry pins the mean execution time we consider 'normal' for a
specific query shape. The nightly job compares the live numbers
against this baseline and posts the top 5 regressions (ranked by
(new_mean - baseline_mean) * new_calls) to the queue-health Slack
and commit the diff. See PG_STAT_STATEMENTS_REGRESSION.md.
The list is intentionally empty on first commit — pg_stat_statements
is in shared_preload_libraries but the extension is not yet created
on the deployed primary (see PROD_REMEDIATION.md). The script is
graceful when the extension is missing and when the baseline is
empty; first refresh will populate it.
